selected_mechanisms.root_cause: ZetaSent emits tx.origin as sourceTxOriginAddress instead of msg.sender. When a contract calls send() for a user, tx.origin is the EOA, not the contract. Downstream validators/relayers parse this for attribution/replay/revert routing; a malicious intermediary can forge apparent sender for any user who granted WZETA allowance.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Unprivileged — any contract calls send() for a user. Attacker deploys contract, victim approves WZETA allowance, attacker calls send() with chosen params; event shows tx.origin=victim EOA.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. victim grants WZETA allowance to AttackerContract. 2. AttackerContract.send(input) attacker-controlled. 3. transferFrom pulls victim WZETA. 4. ZetaSent sourceTxOriginAddress=victim (tx.origin), zetaTxSenderAddress=AttackerContract. 5. relayer sees victim as source; per-origin replay/revert routing misdirected.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Victim EOA — identity forged as originator; reverts may route to victim.
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: Attacker initiates sends attributed to victim; potential WZETA drain under forged attribution.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: tx.origin attribution is a documented anti-pattern enabling phishing/spoofing; field named sourceTxOriginAddress consumed cross-chain; ZetaRevert uses address zetaTxSenderAddress for routing.

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: send() fully permissionless with no cap/validation on zetaValueAndGas/destinationChainId/destinationAddress; cross-chain message and destination fully caller-controlled; no check destinationChainId supported / destinationAddress non-empty.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Unprivileged — any address with WZETA balance + self-allowance.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. send() with unsupported chainId, empty destinationAddress, large value. 2. WZETA transferred + unwrapped. 3. native pushed to FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS. 4. ZetaSent with garbage params. 5. if module doesn't validate, ZETA lost to unresolvable destination.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: Caller (self) or victim (allowance) loses WZETA; protocol if module doesn't reject invalid destinations.
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: No one if lost; attacker if downstream behavior triggered.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Missing input validation on cross-chain params — separate mechanism (different state variable destinationChainId/Address); potential fund loss to invalid destination Medium-High depending on module.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: reentrancy via WZETA.withdraw() — control passes to wzeta which sends ETH back; mutable wzeta could reenter send() before native transfer to FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: WZETA(wzeta).withdraw(input.zetaValueAndGas) then FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS.call{value}(''); receive() only guards msg.sender==wzeta; wzeta mutable via setWzetaAddress.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Whether wzeta is trusted (WETH9-style) or could be set malicious; if reentrant, double-spend by second send() before native transfer.
unresolved_mechanisms.who_loses: Protocol/FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS — double native transfer or disrupted accounting.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: value exceeds bound — no upper bound on zetaValueAndGas
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: used without bounds in transferFrom/withdraw/native call; type(uint256).max accepted if allowance.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Whether withdraw/native call revert on extreme values or corrupt downstream accounting.

rejected_mechanisms.mechanism: stale accounting — ZetaSent cannot decompose value vs gas
rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: event includes both zetaValueAndGas and destinationGasLimit; NatSpec defines composition; consumers can use destinationGasLimit; design choice not correctness bug.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: No fund theft from event layout; only off-chain accounting clarity.

impact_direction.attacker_receives: Cross-chain delivery attributed to victim (tx.origin); revert funds possibly routed to victim; sends with forged originator.
impact_direction.victim_loses: WZETA (if allowance granted); identity forged; potential revert funds misdirected.
impact_direction.invariant_violated: Cross-chain sender attribution: sourceTxOriginAddress does not reliably identify the initiating contract when intermediaries used; ZetaRevert routing may be misdirected.
impact_direction.not_self_funded_or_dust_or_admin_or_timi: tx.origin misattribution requires only victim granting allowance (common); permissionless, not admin/dust/timing.

stop_condition: more_mechanisms_pending: reentrancy via mutable wzeta and unbounded value unresolved; tx.origin misattribution + missing input validation carried
